sentences.japanese: 学生たちは「ハムレット」を演じた。
何を映画で演じてもトムはかっこいい。
sentences.english: No matter what he plays on the screen, Tom looks great.

sentences.japanese: メアリーはその劇で老婆の役を演じた。
sentences.english: Mary played the role of an old woman in the play.

sentences.japanese: マークは一度も舞台で演じたことがなく、不安だった。
sentences.english: Mark had never acted on the stage and he was ill at ease.

sentences.japanese: ボブは今度の学園祭で初めて主役を演じる。
sentences.english: Bob will play the leading role for the first time in the next school festival.
